units.source_text: 阿阇梨带着冷泉院的使者前往参见八亲王。

en.t: The ajari set out with Reizei-in's messenger to pay a visit to Prince Hachi.

units.source_text: 这山阴的庄院里，寻常人的使者也极少来，

en.t: At this mountain-side estate, even messengers from ordinary people rarely came,

units.source_text: 今有冷泉院的御使到门，真乃稀世之事，

en.t: so for an imperial messenger from Reizei-in to arrive at the gate was truly an extraordinary event,

units.source_text: 大家十分欢迎，便拿出当地的酒肴来殷勤招待。

en.t: and everyone welcomed him warmly, bringing out local wine and food to entertain him with great care.
Prince Hachi's poem in reply was:
